channel.title: Relay Updates
channel.description: Signed updates for Relay on macOS.

item.description:
# Relay 0.3.2
Relay can now start automatically when you sign in to your Mac. Open **Library & Settings → Settings → General → This Mac** and turn on **Launch Relay at login**. The switch reflects the current macOS login-item setting; if macOS requires approval, Relay tells you where to finish enabling it.
This release retains the settings search added in 0.3.1 and signed in-app updates. Existing 0.3.x installs can update from **Check for Updates…**; 0.2.0 installs still need one manual installation because they predate the updater.

# Relay 0.3.1
Find macOS settings directly from Relay's **All** search.
- Search for microphone, camera, Wi-Fi, sound, displays, keyboard shortcuts, privacy permissions, and more. - Type **microphone** to see **Microphone permissions** and **Sound input** first. Press Return or double-click a result to open that settings page. - Settings results are clearly marked **System Settings** and appear alongside existing applications, files, snippets, and clipboard results. - Common aliases, English and Greek searches, and macOS's own setting names are supported. Relay remembers the results you choose.
## Install or update
If you already use Relay 0.3.0, choose **Check for Updates…** from the Relay menu.
For a first installation or an upgrade from 0.2.0, download **Relay-0.3.1-macOS.dmg**, save any open Relay drafts, quit Relay, and drag **Relay.app** into **Applications**, replacing the older app. Then reopen Relay. Your library and settings are preserved.
Requires macOS 14 or later, on Intel or Apple Silicon.

# Relay 0.3.0
Relay now checks for new versions and lets you download and install signed updates from inside the app.
- An **Update Available** button appears when a newer version is available. - Use **Check for Updates…** from the Relay menu or **Settings → General → Software Updates**. - Automatic daily checks can be turned off in Settings. You choose when to download and install an update. - Application search now finds additional macOS utilities, including Keychain Access.
## Install or upgrade
Requires macOS 14 or later; supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs.
Download **Relay-0.3.0-macOS.dmg**, save any open Relay drafts, quit Relay, and drag **Relay.app** into **Applications**, replacing the older app when prompted. Open Relay from Applications.
Version 0.2.0 needs this manual upgrade once to enable in-app updates. Your existing library and settings are preserved. For sync on another Mac, use the same Apple Account with iCloud Passwords & Keychain enabled. Allow Relay in **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility** for text expansion and direct paste.
